Tests.Title: Exact retry stable
Tests.Details: Initial and retry produced stable receipt 9bd89b6b3ae348a6b8dee2b6194b3ca2, revision remained 1.

Tests.Title: Same key changed fields -> collision rejected
Tests.Details: All changed material fields were rejected with COLLISION_REJECTED without leaking receipts.

Tests.Title: Semantically identical reordered JSON -> exact retry
Tests.Details: Reordered JSON keys and whitespace were canonicalized into identical RequestFingerprint and accepted as exact retry.

Tests.Title: Caller fake hash cannot influence identity
Tests.Details: Caller-supplied hash was completely ignored; server computed true fingerprint from parsed typed envelope.

Tests.Title: 25+ independent concurrency race -> exactly 1 winner
Tests.Details: 25 concurrent callers produced exactly 1 winner and 24 stale losers. Final revision in DB is 1.

Tests.Title: 10+ same-ID concurrent requests -> typed stable outcomes
Tests.Details: 10 concurrent requests with identical (PrincipalId, OperationId) resolved to 1 initial commit and 9 ALREADY_COMMITTED without SQLite exceptions.

Tests.Title: Storage busy/lock -> bounded typed outcome
Tests.Details: Storage busy returned bounded typed STORAGE_BUSY_RETRYABLE in 5263ms.

Tests.Title: Hard kill before/inside/after commit boundaries
Tests.Details: Verified atomic rollback on pre-commit crash and durable commit survival on post-commit crash.

Tests.Title: Consumer effect success + crash before ACK -> exactly once
Tests.Details: Consumer applied effect once, process crashed before ACK, redelivery was idempotent and semantic effect count remained exactly 1.

Tests.Title: Transient consumer failure -> recovery eventually delivers
Tests.Details: Transient consumer failure did not roll back commit; recovery cleanly redelivered event to consumer.

Tests.Title: Durable ACK + crash -> convergence without duplicate effect
Tests.Details: Durable consumer cursor prevented duplicate replay during subsequent convergence.

Tests.Title: Fresh normal startup creates/validates DB before READY
Tests.Details: Fresh database created, migrated, validated, and PIPELINE_READY reached.

Tests.Title: Restart with pending publication recovers before READY
Tests.Details: Server startup converged pending publication events to consumer before setting PIPELINE_READY.

Tests.Title: Malformed/future schema -> fail closed before network admission
Tests.Details: Future schema version and malformed schema both failed closed with InvalidOperationException.

Tests.Title: Every canonical connection effective WAL/FULL
Tests.Details: 10 independent connections from context verified effective WAL, synchronous=FULL (2), and application_id=WARE.

Tests.Title: Receipt round-trip/hash stable under timezone/culture change
Tests.Details: Receipt epoch ms and hash recomputation remained 100% stable across 6 diverse cultures.

Tests.Title: StoreIncarnation rotation rejects old incarnation identity
Tests.Details: StoreIncarnation successfully rotated from 023fee6bfb754be6b7a27e9a65bade7f to a9df9ca0dd404ad5b1e5b3fc931a973c, and old incarnation request was rejected.

Tests.Title: Actual gameplay dispatcher cannot invoke probe
Tests.Details: Gameplay transport invocation was strictly denied with ACCESS_DENIED.

Tests.Title: No Settlement/material/EntityId/Trade/Tax state touched
Tests.Details: Verified pipeline DB contains exclusively infrastructure tables. No Settlement, material, trade, or tactical state touched.
